subject: What professional fitting protects
hook: Install day, start to finish, in under 30 seconds.
ig:
Install day, start to finish, in under 30 seconds.

This is the order our team works in when they arrive with your furniture:

Wrapped panels come off the van and floors get covered before anything goes inside.

Walls are checked for pipes and cables before a single hole is drilled.

Every carcass is levelled first, because a unit fixed slightly off level throws every door out.

Fillers are scribed to the shape of your wall so the gap disappears.

Doors and drawers are adjusted, soft-close is tested, and we walk you round before we leave.

The furniture is quality-checked in our workshop before it leaves, but the fit is where it either works for years or doesn't.

Want to know how fitting would work in your room? Comment FIT and we'll send our installation page.
fb:
What actually happens when our fitters arrive? Floors covered, walls checked for pipes and cables, every unit levelled before it's fixed, fillers scribed to your walls, then doors and drawers adjusted and a walk-round with you before we go.

It's the unglamorous part of fitted furniture, and the part that decides whether doors still line up a year later. Our installation page explains more, including fitting furniture from other makers.
